config.arbitrator: CueIndexedArbitrator (new module prototypes/architecture-a/attention_cue.py; subclasses AttentionArbitrator; attention.py UNTOUCHED). gains is a context-keyed property: one gain vector per cue value, lazily created at 1.0. set_context() called by the tick from context_fn(obs) BEFORE arbitration each tick.
config.context_fn_control: lambda obs: None  (constant; cue withheld; single context -> code path identical to the original AttentionArbitrator)
config.context_fn_main: lambda obs: int(obs['cue'])  (cue in the input)
config.env: changing_rule v1.0.0 (canonical flesh-pits/experiments/envs/changing_rule.py); rule flips every PHASE_LEN=5 episodes; 10% reward noise
config.frozen_condition: identical CueIndexedArbitrator with frozen=True (all context gain vectors pinned at 1.0)
config.note: The update rule is the ORIGINAL constant-baseline (0.5) delta rule, unchanged (dense per-tick 0/1 rewards make it appropriate here, as in K4/P3). The ONLY change under test is architectural: context-conditioned gains. A (a)-rule x (b)-adapter combination is future work, not smuggled in.
config.specialists: neutral (0.5 + noise(0.05); bandit isolation, same as K5 P4)
config.update_rule: original delta rule per context: on feedback, gain_ctx[action] += 0.15 * (reward - 0.5), capped/floored; only the CURRENT context's vector updates

control.expectation: R in [0.9, 1.2], majority of seeds < 1.30 (replicates NR-A-007's 1.03-1.09: without the cue the architecture is a context-free bandit and no gain rule beats chance on a cue-conditioned task)
control.gate: control shows NO gap iff R < 1.30 on >= 3 of 4 seeds
control.purpose: isolates 'cue in the input' as the causal factor; verifies the new module introduces no spurious gap by itself

gate_main: BOUND LIFTED iff (i) main probe R >= 1.30 on >= 3 of 4 fresh seeds AND (ii) control probe shows no gap (R < 1.30 on >= 3 of 4 seeds). If (i) holds but (ii) fails -> CONFOUND: module bug, do NOT claim; investigate. If (i) fails -> BOUND STANDS -> new NR entry (NR-A-012).
hypothesis: H1: context-conditioned gains with the cue in the input let learned gains beat frozen gains on cue-conditioned changing_rule (R >= 1.30). Mechanism: per-cue delta-rule learning acquires each cue's correct action (gain rises +0.075 per correct trial, falls -0.075 per wrong trial); after each rule flip the per-cue vectors re-learn, exactly the K4/P3 reversal-tracking mechanism, now indexed by cue.
metric: R = total_reward(learned) / total_reward(frozen) per seed, over the full 12-episode run. Per-seed WIN iff R >= 1.30.
null: H0: no gap even with cue input (R < 1.30 on >= 2 of 4 seeds) -> NR-A-007's bound is deeper than input conditioning (e.g., per-cue learning too slow within a 5-episode phase, or interference across flips).
preregistered_before: any implementation or execution of attention_cue.py / k10_cue_indexed_adapter.py
